approved_translation: Perseverance through hardship leads to success; do not abandon your journey halfway.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a merchant, with his goods packed in many carts, came to a desert. He was on his way to the country on the other side of the desert. They set up a flag on the well for travelers to see. At sundown, they started on again, and the next morning reached the city, where they sold the goods, and then returned home.
